BiblicalUsage: Elienai is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 8:20, the text says "And Elienai." The life behind the name is told on the Elienai People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elienai matters because God knows His people by name, and Elienai is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
